Variants.Content: Entry The Royal Council is the core institution for handling state affairs in Iron Throne. It is convened by the king and is responsible for military, judicial, financial, intelligence, naval and religious affairs. It was not a collective cabinet in the modern sense: seats came from royal appointments, aristocratic influence, personal Minutes, secret conversations, and public orders may differ from one another; a minister's institutional responsibilities may also be distorted by his family interests and the king's level of trust.
